summary: Teardown routine for an audio network stream subsystem. If the owner flags at this+0xEC have bit 0x100000 set, it destroys an array of sub-stream objects (count at this+0x160, stride 96, each destructed via DestructorWithConditionalFreeFlagClear), unlinks the array with DoublyLinkedListNodeRemovalWithArrayCleanup, zeroes this+0x160/0x164, frees the shared buffer global dword_8B78A0 via SubBufferFree, and clears the 0x100000 flag. It then destroys the two stream-handle globals dword_8B8DBC and dword_8B8DC0 (sub_542E50, EmptyStub_7470, FreeWrapper_7bcf). Finally it walks three owner lists: if any active tree is found in the list rooted at this+0x100 (child nodes via +0x1EC) or this+0x108 it returns -1 early, otherwise it runs TextureFlagTestWithDispatch over the list rooted at this+0x148 and finishes with sub_540760(dword_8B78A0), returning 0.
